name: Innocent Play
source:
Living in a small town our protagonist is a stay-at-home brother looking out for his sister. A shy and innocent girl, but as he is exposed to her, his feelings will be revealed, will she be corrupted or will this be more than lust?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20221001152900/https://royal-games.itch.io/innocent-play]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们的主角住在一个小镇上，是一位全职哥哥，照顾他的妹妹。一个腼腆纯真的女孩，但当他接触到她的时候，他的感情就会显露出来，她会被腐蚀还是会不仅仅是情欲？

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20221001152900/https://royal-games.itch.io/innocent-play]Itch.io[/url]]
